The questionThe decisionsModelSpec sheet

My independent exploration / ÌTURA

What if Amara
had a stud?

I took the necklace’s heart and soft gold wrap, and explored them as a matching stud.

A stud felt like a natural companion. I wanted a shape of its own, with room for another earring beside it.

My work
Concept, Blender model & renders
Status
Independent digital study
What informed the idea

I started with Amara in ÌTURA’s bestseller edit. Studs with a clear focal stone and a fuller shape, and ways of stacking earrings, informed the direction.

ÌTURA’s bestseller editMejuri’s studs & huggiesMissoma’s stacking approach
Three ideas. One companion.Go to the model

01 / Exploring the companion

Three ideas
for the earring

I tried a smaller heart stud, a folded gold stud and a drop.

Concept illustration

01

Scaled miniature

I tried a smaller version of the necklace. It matched, but I wanted the stud to have a shape of its own.

Chosen direction / concept illustration

02 / My choice

Nest

I kept the heart and wrapped one side in gold. A satin fold and polished edge were the finishes I had in mind.

Concept illustration

03

A drop

The drop was another option. I put it aside because I wanted a matching stud, and ÌTURA already has heart drops.

02 / The Nest stud

The heart, held in a fold.

I kept Amara’s heart and wrapped one side in gold. The fold gives the stud a shape of its own, while leaving the stone open to the light.

View the model

Building the stud

I modelled the shell, seat and prongs in Blender. Here’s the same view with the materials and mesh.
